source_text:
3.22 Τοῦ αὐτοῦ Ἀσπίδων δὲ δήγματι
θεραπεία· κόρεις πλεῖστοι λαμβανόμενοι ἀσπιδοδήκτοις ἄκος εἶναι μέγιστον
πιστεύονται, ἢ χελώνης οὖρον πινόμενον καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ δῆγμα ἐπισταζόμενον καθ' αὑτό
τε καὶ μετὰ πολλῶν κόρεων. Ὁ δὲ ἰατρὸς Φόβιος τοῖς ὑπὸ ἀσπίδων δηχθεῖσι τὴν
καλουμένην «αἱμορροΐδα» ἐδίδου τὸν ὄφιν φρύγων καὶ λειῶν καὶ ἐν οἴνῳ ποτίζων,
καὶ τὸ ἀνάπαλιν τοὺς ὑπὸ αἱμορροΐδος δηχθέντας ὡσαύτως ἀσπίδι χρῆσθαι ἔλεγεν. Ἴναρον γὰρ τὸν Λίβυν ἴαμα ἀλλήλων ἔφασκεν αὐτὸ παραδεδωκέναι.
pass_a_gloss: 3.22 Of-the-same. Of-asps but to-a-bite a-treatment: bedbugs most being-taken to-asp-bitten a-cure to-be greatest they-are-believed, or of-a-tortoise urine being-drunk and upon the bite being-dripped according-to itself both and with many bedbugs. The but physician Phobius to-those by asps having-been-bitten the being-called 'haemorrhois' he-was-giving the snake roasting and pounding and in wine giving-to-drink, and the reverse those by haemorrhois having-been-bitten likewise with-an-asp to-use he-was-saying. Inarus for the Libyan a-remedy of-one-another he-was-affirming it to-have-handed-down.
pass_b_english: Of the same. A treatment for the bite of asps: very many bedbugs, being taken, are believed to be a greatest cure for those bitten by asps; or tortoise-urine being drunk and dripped on the bite, both by itself and with many bedbugs.

The physician Phobius, to those bitten by asps, was giving the snake called haemorrhois, roasting and pounding it and giving it to drink in wine; and the reverse, he was saying those bitten by a haemorrhois should use an asp likewise. For Inarus the Libyan, he was affirming, handed it down as a remedy of one another.

choices.why: Asp and haemorrhois are reciprocal remedies in Phobius's report from Inarus, not 'a remedy for others'.
rejected: they heal each other as people
